newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada-Israel free trade deal starts January 1.
newsitem.headline: Canada-Israel free trade deal starts January 1.

text.p: The Canada-Israel Free Trade Agreement will take effect on January 1 now that both countries' legislatures have approved the deal, a Canadian government trade spokesman said on Monday.
The agreement had been signed on July 31, to remove tariffs on all industrial goods except women's bathing suits and certain cotton fabrics.
Duty-free access or low duties will be applied to a variety of agricultural and fisheries products as well.
Israel's Knesset approved the agreement on Friday, following Canadian parliamentary approval, the spokesman said.
Canada continues its negotiations with Palestinian officials to extend the same benefits to the West Bank and Gaza.
